description: Publish a single-page static HTML site live on the web and get a permanent public URL and shareable link, plus a downloadable dynamic QR code that opens it. Use this when the user asks to create, publish, deploy, host, share, or put online a landing page, one-pager, business page, digital menu, event page, portfolio, product page, campaign page, or microsite — especially when they do not have a website or hosting provider. No separate hosting account, build step, or deployment token is required. Accepts one complete HTML document up to 6 MB: a single file, not a multi-page site. When `qr_id` is provided, update the hosted page in place while preserving its public URL and printed QR code.
